searchText: if you have a large smart contract that you want to submit to ETH, is it possible for the gas fees to cost tens of thousands in USD fees? I am watching a project and the dev is saying they can't submit contract to the Eth blockchain as fee estimate is 10's of thousands in USD The biggest contract you can deploy is something like 8M gas IIRC. At 500 nanoeth per gas that is like 4 ETH. It isn't 10s of thousands, but it is a lot. hmmm they said it was also failing. that they attempted at least a few times. anyways, it ended up deploying later on a new attempt. strange. Thanks Micah
